skill_name: Write an article to explain why people need to start eating healthy foods
workflow: Eating healthy food is essential for living a healthy and happy life. With an increasing number of processed and unhealthy food available on the market, it can be difficult to make the healthier choices. Eating healthy food helps to maintain a strong immune system, promotes a good digestion, and protects against certain illnesses.
